messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['You have 1 unread message(s)...', 'To protect your online security we may call you to confirm your account activity is genuine.', 'This purchase was observed from 217.149.108.102 (Truman, Russia).', 'As a result, your account has been flagged.', 'We recently reviewed your account, and suspect that your Internet Banking Account is being accessed from an unauthorized computer.', 'For the protection of your account we have suspended access to it.', "We've recently noticed that someone has made 3 suspicious attempts to login into your online account from this address 66.221.4.04", 'IMPORTANT - Account Scheduled For Termination', 'Your account has been limited until we hear from you', "As a result, we've reversed this transaction.", 'I attached a screenshot for you your first payment $5,000.00 sent to your name today', 'Your order #74-4211325 accepted.', 'WE HAVE CONCLUDED THAT YOU ARE ELIGIBLE TO RECEIVE A TAX REFUND OF 1,500.89 GBP.', 'Thanks for your order. We’ll let you know once your item(s) have dispatched.', 'You have received a question about eBay item Brand new SONY PSP with 2 Years Warranty', 'You have an unconfirmed payment on your Lloyds online banking account', 'The security update will be effective immediately and requires our customers to update their access.', 'You have been sent an INTERACT Email Money Transfer.', 'Your checking account billing information has been deleted during our recent upgrade and maintenances of our database against Virus.', 'For security reasons, we have temporarily suspended your account and your access to online banking will be restricted if you fail to re-confirm your membership details.', 'You have received a new message', 'YOUR ATM CARD IS READY.', "We've updated the changes you made to your profile."]

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We provide updates about account security, transactions, orders, payments, and profile changes, while notifying you of required actions, restrictions, and important messages."}
